# has end instant

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasEndInstant`](gmeow-hasEndInstant.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasEndInstant>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The end instant of a time interval; absent if the interval is open-ended.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md) -> [`gmeow:Instant`](../classes/gmeow-Instant.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:hasEndInstant`](gmeow-hasEndInstant.md) from [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md) to [`gmeow:Instant`](../classes/gmeow-Instant.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to bound an interval's close with a full [`gmeow:Instant`](../classes/gmeow-Instant.md) when that endpoint needs its own frame, granularity, determinacy, or EDTF value — the reified counterpart of [`gmeow:endedAtTime`](gmeow-endedAtTime.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid when a bare crisp dateTime suffices (use [`gmeow:endedAtTime`](gmeow-endedAtTime.md)) and avoid asserting two end instants (functional); omit it entirely for an interval that is still open.

### How to use

- Point the interval at a single [`gmeow:Instant`](../classes/gmeow-Instant.md); its absence (not a sentinel) signals an open-ended interval, mirroring [`gmeow:endedAtTime`](gmeow-endedAtTime.md).

### Examples

- ex:tenureInterval [`gmeow:hasEndInstant`](gmeow-hasEndInstant.md) ex:departureInstant.
